premise: Bird teaches Duckling his song, but all Duckling can sing is QUACK; Bee hums, Frog croaks, and the quack turns out to be exactly the big finish the song was missing.
inspiration: The Bremen Town Musicians (Grimm), where odd voices make a band, turned: nobody leaves home, and the voice that seemed wrong is the finale.
lesson: Your own voice has its place.

en-US.title: Duckling Learns a Song
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bird:enter by hop} Bird hopped through the grass, singing. Tweet-a-lee, tweet-a-loo! {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to bird} Duckling waddled after him. {duckling:face happy} [excited] "Teach me!" So Bird sang, and Duckling tried. {duckling:live quack} {sfx:quack} QUACK. {duckling:face sad} [sad] "That's not it," said Duckling. {bird:hop} "Again!" said Bird, and sang it slowly: tweet… a… lee… Duckling took a big breath. QUACK. {bee:enter} {bee:go to bird} Bee came buzzing over to listen, {bee:live hum} and hummed along. Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to duckling} Frog came hopping. {sfx:ribbit} Ribbit, ribbit! {frog:hop} [sighs] "Everyone can sing but me," said Duckling. {bird:face happy} [warmly] "Then let's all sing together," said Bird. "Tweet-a-lee!" {bee:wobble} Mmm! {frog:live croak} Ribbit! {bird:live sing hold} And Bird held the last note, long and high… waiting. {duckling:face surprised} The song needed a big finish. But Duckling felt shy, {duckling:live nap} so he hid his head under his wing… then out he popped, and — {sfx:quack} QUACK! {bird:live sing resume} [laughs] "That's IT!" cried Bird. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Everyone cheered. [happily] And now the forest song goes: tweet-a-lee, mmm, ribbit… QUACK!

es-ES.title: La canción de Patito
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bird:enter by hop} Pájaro iba dando saltitos por la hierba, cantando: ¡tiruri-lí, tiruri-ló! {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to bird} Patito fue detrás, anadeando. {duckling:face happy} [excited] —¡Enséñame! Así que Pájaro cantó, y Patito lo intentó. {duckling:live quack} {sfx:quack} CUAC. {duckling:face sad} [sad] —Así no es —dijo Patito. {bird:hop} —¡Otra vez! —dijo Pájaro, y la cantó despacito: ti… ru… ri… lí… Patito cogió mucho aire. CUAC. {bee:enter} {bee:go to bird} Abeja se acercó zumbando a escuchar {bee:live hum} y tarareó con ellos. Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to duckling} Rana llegó saltando. {sfx:ribbit} ¡Croac, croac! {frog:hop} [sighs] —Todos sabéis cantar menos yo —dijo Patito. {bird:face happy} [warmly] —Pues cantemos todos juntos —dijo Pájaro—. ¡Tiruri-lí! {bee:wobble} ¡Mmm! {frog:live croak} ¡Croac! {bird:live sing hold} Y Pájaro sostuvo la última nota, larga y aguda… esperando. {duckling:face surprised} A la canción le faltaba un final por todo lo alto. A Patito le dio vergüenza, {duckling:live nap} y escondió la cabeza bajo el ala… pero de pronto asomó y… {sfx:quack} ¡CUAC! {bird:live sing resume} [laughs] —¡ESO ES! —gritó Pájaro. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Todos lo celebraron. [happily] Y desde entonces, la canción del bosque dice así: tiruri-lí, mmm, croac… ¡CUAC!

ja-JP.title: アヒルの子と 森の歌
ja-JP.text: {bee:float loop 0.4}{bird:enter by hop}ことりが、うたいながら、ぴょんぴょん。ピロリロピー、ピロリロルー！{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to bird}アヒルの子が、よちよちついてきて、{duckling:face happy}[excited]「ぼくにもおしえて！」 ことりがうたって、アヒルの子もまねっこ。{duckling:live quack}{sfx:quack}ガー。{duckling:face sad}[sad]「ちがう…」 {bird:hop}「もういっかい！」 ことりは、ゆっくりうたいます。ピ…ロ…リ…ロ…。アヒルの子は、すうっといきをすって…ガー。{bee:enter}{bee:go to bird}ミツバチさんもききにきて、{bee:live hum}ふんふーん。{frog:enter}{frog:go to duckling}カエルさんも、ぴょこぴょこ。{sfx:ribbit}ケロケロ！{frog:hop}[sighs]「みんなうたえるのに、ぼくだけ…」 {bird:face happy}[warmly]「じゃあ、みんなでうたおう！ピロリロピー！」 {bee:wobble}ふんふん！{frog:live croak}ケロケロ！{bird:live sing hold}ことりは、さいごの音を、たかーくのばして…まっています。{duckling:face surprised}さいごに、大きなひと声がほしいところ。でもアヒルの子は、はずかしくて、{duckling:live nap}つばさにあたまをかくして…ぴょこんとかおを出すと——{sfx:quack}ガーッ！{bird:live sing resume}[laughs]「それそれ！」 とことり。{all:face happy}{all:hop x2}みんなで、ばんざい！[happily]いまでは森の歌は、ピロリロピー、ふんふん、ケロケロ…ガーッ！

de-DE.title: Das Entchen singt mit
de-DE.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bird:enter by hop} Der Vogel hüpfte singend durchs Gras. Tirili, tirilo! {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to bird} Das Entchen watschelte hinterher. {duckling:face happy} [excited] „Zeig’s mir!“ Der Vogel sang vor, das Entchen sang nach. {duckling:live quack} {sfx:quack} QUAK. {duckling:face sad} [sad] „Nein, so nicht“, sagte das Entchen. {bird:hop} „Noch mal!“, sagte der Vogel und sang ganz langsam: Ti… ri… li… Das Entchen holte tief Luft. QUAK. {bee:enter} {bee:go to bird} Die Biene kam herbeigesummt, um zuzuhören, {bee:live hum} und summte mit. Summ, summ. {frog:enter} {frog:go to duckling} Der Frosch kam angehüpft. {sfx:ribbit} Koax, koax! {frog:hop} [sighs] „Alle können singen, nur ich nicht“, sagte das Entchen. {bird:face happy} [warmly] „Dann singen wir alle zusammen!“, sagte der Vogel. „Tirili!“ {bee:wobble} Summ! {frog:live croak} Koax! {bird:live sing hold} Der Vogel hielt den letzten Ton, lang und hoch… und wartete. {duckling:face surprised} Dem Lied fehlte noch ein großer Schluss. Aber das Entchen war schüchtern {duckling:live nap} und steckte den Kopf unter den Flügel… dann, schwupp, kam es hervor und – {sfx:quack} QUAK! {bird:live sing resume} [laughs] „GENAU das hat gefehlt!“, rief der Vogel. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Alle jubelten. [happily] Seitdem geht das Waldlied so: Tirili, summ, koax… QUAK!

fr-FR.title: La chanson de Caneton
fr-FR.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bird:enter by hop} Oiseau sautillait dans l’herbe en chantant. Tiri-li, tiri-lou ! {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to bird} Caneton le suivait en se dandinant. {duckling:face happy} [excited] « Apprends-moi ! » Alors Oiseau a chanté, et Caneton a essayé. {duckling:live quack} {sfx:quack} COIN. {duckling:face sad} [sad] « Ce n’est pas ça », a dit Caneton. {bird:hop} « Encore ! » a dit Oiseau, et il l’a chantée lentement : ti… ri… li… Caneton a pris une grande inspiration. COIN. {bee:enter} {bee:go to bird} Abeille est venue écouter en bourdonnant, {bee:live hum} et a fredonné avec eux. Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to duckling} Grenouille est arrivée en sautant. {sfx:ribbit} Croâ, croâ ! {frog:hop} [sighs] « Tout le monde sait chanter, sauf moi », a dit Caneton. {bird:face happy} [warmly] « Alors chantons tous ensemble, a dit Oiseau. Tiri-li ! » {bee:wobble} Mmm ! {frog:live croak} Croâ ! {bird:live sing hold} Et Oiseau a tenu la dernière note, longue et haute… en attendant. {duckling:face surprised} La chanson avait besoin d’une grande fin. Mais Caneton était timide : {duckling:live nap} il s’est caché la tête sous l’aile… puis il a surgi, et — {sfx:quack} COIN ! {bird:live sing resume} [laughs] « C’est ÇA ! » a crié Oiseau. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Tout le monde a applaudi. [happily] Et maintenant, la chanson de la forêt fait : tiri-li, mmm, croâ… COIN !

it-IT.title: La canzone di Anatroccolo
it-IT.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bird:enter by hop} Uccellino saltellava nell'erba e cantava: cirilì, cirilò! {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to bird} Anatroccolo gli è andato dietro, dondolando. {duckling:face happy} [excited] «Insegnami!» Così Uccellino ha cantato, e Anatroccolo ci ha provato. {duckling:live quack} {sfx:quack} QUA QUA. {duckling:face sad} [sad] «Non è così», ha detto Anatroccolo. {bird:hop} «Di nuovo!» ha detto Uccellino, e l'ha cantata piano piano: ci… ri… lì… Anatroccolo ha preso un gran respiro. QUA QUA. {bee:enter} {bee:go to bird} Ape è arrivata ronzando ad ascoltare, {bee:live hum} e si è messa a canticchiare anche lei. Mmm-mmm. {frog:enter} {frog:go to duckling} Rana è arrivata saltando. {sfx:ribbit} Cra cra, cra cra! {frog:hop} [sighs] «Tutti sanno cantare, tranne me», ha detto Anatroccolo. {bird:face happy} [warmly] «Allora cantiamo tutti insieme», ha detto Uccellino. «Cirilì!» {bee:wobble} Mmm! {frog:live croak} Cra cra! {bird:live sing hold} E Uccellino ha tenuto l'ultima nota, lunga e acuta… e aspettava. {duckling:face surprised} Alla canzone mancava un gran finale. Ma Anatroccolo si vergognava, {duckling:live nap} e ha nascosto la testa sotto l'ala… poi è saltato fuori, e — {sfx:quack} QUA QUA! {bird:live sing resume} [laughs] «Ecco, PROPRIO così!» ha gridato Uccellino. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Tutti hanno gridato evviva. [happily] E adesso la canzone del bosco fa così: cirilì, mmm, cra cra… QUA QUA!

zh-TW.title: 小鴨學唱歌
zh-TW.text: {bee:float loop 0.4}{bird:enter by hop}小鳥在草地上一跳一跳，一邊唱歌：啾哩啾，啾哩啾！{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to bird}小鴨搖搖擺擺地跟在後面。{duckling:face happy}[excited]「教我唱！」 於是小鳥唱，小鴨跟著學。{duckling:live quack}{sfx:quack}嘎！{duckling:face sad}[sad]「不是這樣。」 小鴨說。{bird:hop}「再一次！」 小鳥說，然後慢慢地唱：啾……哩……啾……小鴨深深吸了一口氣。嘎！{bee:enter}{bee:go to bird}蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡地飛過來聽，{bee:live hum}也跟著哼。嗯——嗯——{frog:enter}{frog:go to duckling}青蛙跳了過來。{sfx:ribbit}呱呱，呱呱！{frog:hop}[sighs]「大家都會唱歌，只有我不會。」 小鴨說。{bird:face happy}[warmly]「那我們大家一起唱吧！」 小鳥說，「啾哩啾！」 {bee:wobble}嗯——！{frog:live croak}呱呱！{bird:live sing hold}小鳥把最後一個音拉得長長的、高高的……等著。{duckling:face surprised}這首歌，還少一個響亮的結尾。可是小鴨好害羞，{duckling:live nap}把頭藏進翅膀底下……接著，一下子冒出來——{sfx:quack}嘎！{bird:live sing resume}[laughs]「就是這個！」 小鳥大叫。{all:face happy}{all:hop x2}大家一起歡呼。[happily]現在，森林之歌是這樣唱的：啾哩啾，嗯——，呱呱……嘎！

zh-HK.title: 小鴨學唱歌
zh-HK.text: {bee:float loop 0.4}{bird:enter by hop}小鳥在草地上一跳一跳，一邊唱歌：吱吱啾，吱吱喳！{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to bird}小鴨一搖一擺地跟在後面。{duckling:face happy}[excited]「教我唱呀！」 於是小鳥唱，小鴨跟着學。{duckling:live quack}{sfx:quack}嘎！{duckling:face sad}[sad]「唔係咁㗎。」 小鴨說。{bird:hop}「再嚟！」 小鳥說，然後唱得慢慢的：吱……吱……啾……小鴨深深吸了一口氣。嘎！{bee:enter}{bee:go to bird}蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡地飛過來聽，{bee:live hum}也跟着哼。嗯——嗯——{frog:enter}{frog:go to duckling}青蛙跳了過來。{sfx:ribbit}呱呱，呱呱！{frog:hop}[sighs]「個個都識唱歌，淨係我唔識。」 小鴨說。{bird:face happy}[warmly]「咁我哋一齊唱啦！」 小鳥說，「吱吱啾！」 {bee:wobble}嗯——！{frog:live croak}呱呱！{bird:live sing hold}小鳥把最後一個音拉得長長的、高高的……等着。{duckling:face surprised}這首歌，還欠一個響亮的結尾。可是小鴨很害羞，{duckling:live nap}把頭藏進翅膀底下……然後，一下子鑽了出來——{sfx:quack}嘎！{bird:live sing resume}[laughs]「就係呢個喇！」 小鳥大叫。{all:face happy}{all:hop x2}大家一起歡呼。[happily]現在，森林之歌就是這樣唱的：吱吱啾，嗯——，呱呱……嘎！
